indic_is.E_AI_ADOWN: Enterprises' AI technologies were developed by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_AEXT: Enterprises' AI technologies were  developed or modified by external providers
indic_is.E_AI_AMOWN: Enterprises' AI technologies were commercial software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_AOS: Enterprises' AI technologies were open-source software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_ARDY: Enterprises' AI technologies were commercial software or systems ready to use
indic_is.E_AI_BCDP: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of concerns regarding violation of data protection and privacy
indic_is.E_AI_BCST: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because the costs seem too high
indic_is.E_AI_BDDT: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of difficulties with availability or quality of the necessary data
indic_is.E_AI_BEC: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of ethical considerations
indic_is.E_AI_BINC: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of incompatibility with existing equipment, software or systems
indic_is.E_AI_BLE: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of relevant expertise
indic_is.E_AI_BLEG: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of clarity about the legal consequences
indic_is.E_AI_BNU: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because artificial Intelligence technologies are not useful for Enterprise
indic_is.E_AI_CC: Enterprises use AI technologies and buy any cloud computing services used over the internet
indic_is.E_AI_DA: Enterprises use AI technologies and perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AI_EC: Enterprises that ever considered to use one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_P1GE2: Enterprises using AI technologies for at least two of the purposes: AI_PMS, AI_PPP, AI_PBAM, AI_PLOG, AI_PITS, AI_PFIN, AI_PRDI
indic_is.E_AI_P1GE3: Enterprises using AI technologies for at least three of the purposes: AI_PMS, AI_PPP, AI_PBAM, AI_PLOG, AI_PITS, AI_PFIN, AI_PRDI
indic_is.E_AI_PBAM: Enterprises using AI technologies for organisation of business administration processes or management
indic_is.E_AI_PFIN: Enterprises using AI technologies for accounting, controlling or finance management
indic_is.E_AI_PITS: Enterprises using AI technologies for ICT security
indic_is.E_AI_PLOG: Enterprises using AI technologies for logistics
indic_is.E_AI_PMS: Enterprises using AI technologies for marketing or sales
indic_is.E_AI_PPP: Enterprises using AI technologies for production processes
indic_is.E_AI_PRDI: Enterprises using AI technologies for research and development (R&D) or innovation activity
indic_is.E_AI_TANY: Enterprises using at least one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TAR: Enterprises using AI technologies enabling physical movement of machines via autonomous decisions based on observation of surroundings (autonomous robots, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones)
indic_is.E_AI_TGE2: Enterprises using at least two of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TGE3: Enterprises using at least three of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TIR: Enterprises using AI technologies identifying objects or persons based on images (image recognition, image processing)
indic_is.E_AI_TML: Enterprises using machine learning (e.g. deep learning) for data analysis
indic_is.E_AI_TNLG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating written or spoken language or programming codes (natural language generation, speech synthesis)
indic_is.E_AI_TPA: Enterprises using AI technologies automating different workflows or assisting in decision making (AI based software robotic process automation)
indic_is.E_AI_TPVSG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating pictures, videos, sound/audio
indic_is.E_AI_TSR: Enterprises using AI technologies converting spoken language into machine-readable format (speech recognition)
indic_is.E_AI_TTM: Enterprises using AI technologies performing analysis of written language (text mining)
indic_is.E_AI_TX: Enterprises don't use any of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
